title: Sculpting
summary: How you sculpt: Multires on a quad base or dynamic topology / voxel remesh, how fine the detail goes, face sets and masks, and how the sculpt hands over to a clean game mesh.

request.brief: Submit a sculpt as you keep it: the sculpt object (with its Multires levels, if you use them) and, if you have it, the clean mesh you retopologised from it.
must_include: Your retopo or base mesh, if you have one
ideas: a sculpted prop with a game mesh

questions.ask: Do you sculpt in Blender, ZBrush or something else, and how do you get to the game mesh?
